display_name: Banking Prudential & Crypto — CRR3, CRD6 & MiCA
description: Structured knowledge graph for EU banking prudential framework (CRR3/Regulation (EU) 2024/1623 and CRD6/Directive 2024/1619) and EU crypto-asset regulation (MiCA/Regulation (EU) 2023/1114).
